title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2611.24637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. translated_title: Hypnos：面向边缘端可扩展持续学习的双阶段端到端平台
translated_abstract: 持续学习（CL）使神经网络能够通过缓解灾难性遗忘来适应非平稳数据流，为构建稳健、保护隐私且可自适应的边缘设备提供了一条路径。然而，将持续学习移植到真实世界的边缘设备上仍面临两大挑战：（i）在线运行，即传感器数据一次只到达一个样本，设备必须即时适应；（ii）边缘设备的低资源占用特性，使得传统的误差反向传播训练变得难以实现。受大脑清醒与睡眠周期的启发——前者以最小资源实现快速适应，后者负责长期巩固——我们提出了Hypnos，一个面向边缘端高效持续学习的开源双阶段平台。在清醒阶段（如日常运行），Hypnos依靠搭载RISC-V微控制器单元（MCU）的低功耗片上系统，实现高效推理并支持轻量级的无梯度原型更新。在睡眠阶段……
tldr: 提出了受大脑清醒-睡眠周期启发的开源双阶段平台Hypnos，在清醒阶段利用搭载RISC-V微控制器的低功耗芯片实现高效推理与无梯度原型更新，从而在资源受限的边缘设备上实现可扩展的持续学习。
en_tdlr: Hypnos is an open-source dual-phase platform inspired by the brain's wake-sleep cycles that enables scalable continual learning on resource-constrained edge devices, using a low-footprint RISC-V MCU-based system-on-chip for efficient inference and lightweight gradient-free prototype updates during the wake phase.
